name: Power and build dependency
description: OpenRepublic synthetic powered mine/smelter chain. A timber-fed power_line construction site must finish before it produces wire, which the powered smelter needs before steel output can start. The power links are explicit fixture links; the site is a synthetic production prerequisite.
catalog:
openrepublic-economy 1
resource timber
resource wire
resource ore
resource steel
utility power
building generator 1 1
  recipe generate every 1 out power:4
end
building timber_farm 1 1
  store timber 32
  recipe harvest every 1 out timber:1
end
building power_line 1 1
  store timber 32
  store wire 32
  build timber:2 work 3
  recipe wire every 1 out wire:1
end
building powered_mine 1 1
  store ore 32
  recipe extract every 1 in power:2 out ore:1
end
building smelter 1 1
  store ore 32
  store wire 32
  store steel 32
  recipe smelt every 1 in ore:1 wire:1 power:2 out steel:1
end
vehicle truck capacity 8 speed 4
